records.title: Implementation of Indo-Bhutan Friendship Treaty
details:
(a) whether Government has reviewed the ongoing implementation of the Indo-Bhutan Friendship Treaty (2007) to address emerging trans-border ecological threats, specifically up-stream deforestation, landslides and siltation affecting the Bodoland Territorial Region (BTR) and adjoining plains of Assam; and
(b) whether the mandate of existing bilateral bodies, including the Joint Group of Experts (JGE) and Joint Technical Team (JTT) is being expanded under diplomatic channels to include collaborative mountain-ecosystem management in the tributaries flowing through BTR region of Assam?
